chapters.title: Chapter 1 The Reborn Boy
paragraphs: Zhao An looked at his hands and the calendar on the wall. He actually returned to the age of sixteen! This is not scientific at all. He remembered that he was just an office worker in a factory. His last memory was a fire in the firecracker factory, and there was no result.
"Is it really reborn?" Zhao An clenched his fists, feeling the strength in his muscles, and he stepped on the ground firmly. Ghosts are floating.

"Ding! Congratulations to the host for successfully traveling through time after death and binding the encyclopedia system. As long as you repeat the same thing five times, you can get all the knowledge and rewards in this field. This system is activated as a reward for surviving a disaster. Please feel free to experience it. This system is valid for life!" A pleasant female voice came.
Zhao An was a little confused. Is this something that only happens in novels?
According to the female voice, Zhao An did five push-ups.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for acquiring fitness knowledge and increasing physical fitness. His current strength is 200 kilograms."

A stream of knowledge poured into Zhao An's head. All the knowledge related to fitness poured into his mind. With this knowledge, he had no problem taking the coach and nutritionist exams. He also knew how to train shark muscles and six-pack abs. Training alone would not work.

Although his head was a little dizzy, this was the situation after the infusion of knowledge. Zhao An's smile gradually became unbridled. He had a bold idea! He wanted to vent all the grievances and dissatisfaction he had suffered before. He wanted to snatch the class flower that he couldn't get before and play with it. He wanted to make the rich second generation that he didn't dare to offend before bow down to him!
Take the pocket money and come to the street under the apartment and come to the lottery shop.

Zhao An took the lottery ticket of five yuan a piece and took five lottery tickets at random. The shop was still a little lively. There were many people dreaming of getting rich, but most of them were just leeks being slaughtered.
Zhao An scratched the lottery ticket casually with a tentative mood.
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for obtaining the knowledge of lottery rules!" The pleasant female voice sounded again.
There were more things in Zhao An's head, and strange knowledge increased!
Looking up again, the gambling numbers on the wall formed a series of charts, and the next scene was the sequence table that was about to appear.
This change shocked Zhao An. This is too amazing! So he bought a ticket before the lottery draw every ten minutes, ten times the five-choice-five, a total of twenty yuan.
After waiting for two minutes, when the winning number was consistent with the number he bet on, Zhao An's heartbeat suddenly accelerated, and he won the prize!
"Congratulations, young man." The owner of the lottery shop handed Zhao An five thousand four hundred yuan.
"Thank you." Zhao An took over five thousand yuan, and his heart was beating. This was his first money in his life!

After getting the money, Zhao An went to another store far away to continue betting. This time, he bet on the lottery, which was opened three times a week. The prize money seemed to be as high as more than 600 million yuan. Zhao An bought 1,000 yuan in one go. If he won, the prize money would be as high as 600 million yuan! Even after tax, it would be more than 400 million yuan. This is a real wave of fat!

After buying a bottle of milk tea and a pack of cigarettes, Zhao An squatted on the corner of the street, where he could see many beauties. He used to be a loser, an ordinary office worker, earning 3,000 yuan a month, like a poor man.

Looking at the woman with hot pants and big white legs, Zhao An made up his mind that he would have enough fun in this life, and take care of all the women he wanted to play with and make them pregnant. He would keep a mother and daughter, let them get pregnant with his children, and then take wedding photos with big bellies!

A pair of mother and daughter who could not be played with because of moral constraints, with big bellies, with his own seeds inside, took photos in wedding dresses. When Zhao An thought of this scene, he was so excited that he couldn't speak. Well, he was just a loser, and he only had a dream of making money and playing with women!
People always have to have some dreams in life, and Zhao An's dream is to be a rich first generation.

Walking on the street, a phone call came in. It was from his mother Zhao Xinlei, "Xiao An, I'm still on a business trip. I'll go back in a few days. Take care of yourself. What gift do you want? I'll bring it back to you."

The mother is a lawyer. As a strong woman, she raised Zhao An alone after the divorce. As a lawyer, she always has an aura of majesty without anger. Zhao An is more afraid of her than a tiger. He has been taught to be self-disciplined since he was a child.

In addition to being a lawyer, the mother is also a great beauty. Her plump figure is just right. She has both the plumpness of a mature woman and the slenderness of a young girl. The unique temperament of a strong woman makes people dare not approach. As a lawyer, she always makes people feel a little scared, just like a teacher, but can't help wanting to conquer.
"Nothing, just come back safely, I will take good care of myself." Zhao An said lightly.
"Okay, Xiao An, that's it, see you in a few days." The mother's voice was a little apologetic. She couldn't take care of her son all the time, which was a dereliction of duty.
Zhao An didn't complain much. When he thought of his mother's mature and plump figure, he had some fantasies. Snap! Zhao An slapped himself to stop thinking about it.

Back in the apartment, Zhao An began to browse the knowledge of stocks. After opening an account, he specially selected the lowest stocks to buy. One lot of stocks is two hundred yuan, and five times cost one thousand yuan.
In an instant, Zhao An understood how stocks work. This is too cool!
"Hehe, is it so easy to make money?" Zhao An sneered. In his eyes, stocks have another curve, which is the increase in each time period.

If you buy a stock neatly, this stock will hit the daily limit tomorrow. If you sell it in the afternoon, you can make at least 200,000 yuan! Using 5,000 to make 200,000 is nothing in the stock market. All miracles are possible.
While Zhao An was working hard to control the computer, a wave of knowledge about computer software programs flooded into his mind. This is the knowledge of hackers!
After receiving this information, Zhao An's smile gradually became more unbridled.
He could hide himself perfectly and hack into various servers to steal information. He even knew how to make software and use remote control to make financial transfers without being detected.
"This encyclopedia system is too perverted!" Zhao An's ideas gradually became bolder!

He hacked into his mother's mobile phone using a computer and saw a plump and graceful figure in the hazy smoke in the bathroom on the computer. It was a little unclear, but Zhao An saw it at a glance. It was his lawyer mother Zhao Xinlei! Seeing this scene, Zhao An's nosebleed almost came out. This is too erotic!

chapters.title: Chapter 2 Invitation from a Friend
paragraphs: "Want to go out and play, great talent?" A phone call came, bringing Zhao An, who was about to rush, back to reality. This was Zhang Chang, one of the few good friends, whose family was said to have some connections.
Zhao An pulled his thoughts back to reality, "Sure, where to go?"
"Hey, how about going to an Internet cafe?" Zhang Chang laughed, he was a senior Internet addict.
"It's a bit boring, just going to play games?" Zhao An is not interested in games now, but is more interested in how to make money and hunt for beauties.
"When did you change your nature? That's right, you are a great talent, we can't go to a disco, and we don't dare to find a few girls to drink. It's really boring." Zhang Chang also said helplessly.
"You have a lot of books at home, right?" Zhao An suddenly thought of something, he needed a little test.
"A lot, do you want to come over? I'll drive you." Zhang Chang said carelessly.

"No, I'll ride my bike over there." Zhao An shook his head, he was now a sponge, absorbing a lot of knowledge, he wanted to enrich himself. He is just an ordinary family. If he wants to counterattack the second generation of rich people and officials, he needs a lot of knowledge. If he wants to counterattack those white, rich and beautiful women, he must show his unique strength.
"Okay, call me when you come over." Zhang Chang hung up the phone after saying that.
"Ding! Unlock telepathy and know the inner activities of the character Zhang Chang." The system prompt sounded.
Zhao An focused his attention on the panel, and he really heard Zhang Chang's voice, "As long as Zhao An comes, I will have the opportunity to go out and play. Hey, reading is useless!"

Hearing this, Zhao An's eyes flickered a few times. Is he going to use himself as a shield? And the system is really effective, "Five-word rule, I can know what he thinks after talking to Zhang Chang for five sentences. Is it the same with other people?"

In addition to knowing Zhang Chang's thoughts, Zhao An also found that he could know the other party's detailed information, even his interests and hobbies. And in this, the two words "cuckold" made Zhao An's eyes widen a little.

He had never thought that his classmate was actually a guy with a cuckold hobby. They usually watched movies together, but they didn't notice it at all. This is indeed a bit hidden. As for suspicion, Zhao An didn't doubt it. He knew that it must be true and the system would not lie.

Zhang Chang's mother, Xia Yaxuan, is a host in the TV station. She is beautiful and has a sweet voice. She is 1.6 meters tall and has a pretty and fair face. She often wears high heels and casual skirts. She doesn't look like a mother with a teenage son at all. And she has a husband who is a leader in the police station. She basically gets off work on time. It is the life that women yearn for most. The only disadvantage may be that she can't become rich. Once she becomes rich, she will be prepared to wait for the Commission for Discipline Inspection to check for corruption.

Seeing this, Zhao An's eyes flickered a few times. Maybe he can get more! After these four words "friend's mother" popped out, his heartbeat began to accelerate. A beautiful and elegant host mature woman, this would make him unable to control himself. I didn't dare to think about it before, because I didn't have the ability. Now I have the ability. The thoughts that I didn't dare to think about before are constantly taking root in my head, especially after seeing my mother's hazy plump body, my heartbeat is uncontrollably beating wildly.

I rode a bicycle to a residential area. This is a residential area for government officials. There are guards with real guns and live ammunition stationed outside the door. You can't live here just because you have money. You must have power and influence. This is also a symbol of status. It is the opposite of another wealthy community in the city. One is inhabited by dignitaries and the other is inhabited by elite rich people. Rich people will only help rich people.

After informing the guard outside the door and verifying it by phone, Zhao An was able to go in. There are surveillance cameras everywhere, and guards are patrolling regularly. The security level here is very high. Ordinary thieves dare not come here. Those who dare to come are either stupid or terrorists.
Coming to the 19th floor, looking at these fine decorations, Zhao An strengthened his determination. He wants to be a rich man, a powerful man.

The memories before rebirth are still vivid. His memories are not of a teenager. He is destined not to be like a high school student, studying and doing exams, burying his head in study. He has to live a different and wonderful life.

As soon as he arrived at Zhang Chang's house, he saw a man supporting a woman, "Zhao An, you are here to find Xiao Chang, right? You came at the right time, help your Aunt Xia go in, I have something else to do, thank you for your hard work."
Zhang Chang's father handed his wife to Zhao An, and left in a hurry, busy almost every day.
Zhao An's breathing was a little hurried, "Okay, uncle."
The door opened, Zhang Chang opened the door, and saw his mother drunk and supported by his friend, a little confused, "What's going on?"

"I just met your father at the door, he asked me to help Auntie in. Why don't you come to help?" Zhao An grabbed Aunt Xia's white jade hand with one hand, and supported her waist with the other hand. Through the evening dress, he could clearly feel the softness of the waist, and bursts of mature woman's fragrance came to his nose.
"Tsk, it's not a big deal, the room is on the second floor, you help my mother up, we will have some fun later." Zhang Chang didn't help, but walked into the room instead.

Zhao An could hear his friend's inner monologue, "Mom, this slut, drank again, so slutty. I don't know if Zhao An, this young man, took the opportunity to take advantage of her. I guess that boy doesn't have the courage. Mom is drunk, it's just right, I can go out and have fun."
Hearing this, Zhao An's eyes flickered a few times. It was really a great cheat to be able to hear the other party's inner activities.

Helping Aunt Xia upstairs, this is a duplex structure. Although it is a single floor, the height is enough to make it a duplex. This will be much more convenient when doing other things, and it also looks much more upscale.
Zhao An helped Aunt Xia upstairs, and the breath of mature women kept blowing in his face, which made him more and more restless.
"Zhang Chang is a cuckold. If he can help, wouldn't it be a good opportunity?"

As soon as this thought came out, Zhao An was shocked. His big hands unconsciously stroked Aunt Xia's slender waist. It was really hard to imagine how the other party maintained herself. It was not too much to compare with a young girl!

paragraphs: After solving the principal's problem, the next step is to make a higher-level layout. Zhao An doesn't need to do anything. He just needs to use everyone's psychological activities and grab the other party's handle to do things for himself. At the same time, he also needs to create a feeling that he has a very strong background, is rich, and has a lot of connections. That's enough.
As for the truth? Who would know that he is actually a poor loser?
It took an afternoon for Zhao An to pretend to interview people and go around with his student ID card. The result is that he can grasp the other party's heart through five simple questions.
So far, Zhao An has taken down one-third of the layout. Now he just needs to enjoy the results with peace of mind, and everything is under control.

Opening his mobile phone, there is a text message from Principal Du inviting him to dinner, but he didn't answer the call. After realizing that Zhao An is a person with a big background, the leaders above him called him to ask about Zhao An's situation. There seems to be some eagerness in the tone, and there is also a trace of fear, which makes Principal Du's heart start to beat. He didn't know that there is such a great god in his school.

There are indeed many great people in the No. 1 Middle School, but these second-generation children are all honest and none of them can be like Zhao An. It seems that there is a huge force behind Zhao An.
Maybe he is a family child who came out to gain experience? Principal Du had an idea in his mind. It is not impossible, but it is very likely.
Zhao An is checking the stocks. The stocks sold have been traded and 200,000 has been deposited into the account!
Looking at the five zeros above, Zhao An was excited. He had never seen so much money in his previous life. Now that he has the system, money is just a number to him.
Although it was expected, when Zhao An really saw the series of numbers, his heartbeat was still accelerating. This money is too much!
"One day, I will get everything I want and take back everything I can't get!"
If it weren't for Aunt Xia's incident before, Zhao An would have taken money to the red light district to find a few prostitutes to vent, or go to the club to play with young models.
Now Zhao An's mentality has changed. He either plays with beautiful class beauties or mature and sexy women. As for prostitutes? He doesn't even bother to touch them.
A phone call came in. It was from his good friend Zhang Chang. "Hey, brother, what are your plans tonight?"
"No, what do you want?" Zhao An had to go out at night. He had to deal with those low-class guys. With a strong physique and fighting skills, he could beat ten or even a hundred of them!

"Hey, my mom is recording a show, and my dad is working overtime. I'm going to your house for tutoring. I told my mom." Zhang Chang smiled. He was still very afraid of his parents. What can a second-generation kid in the first year of high school do?
"I'll tell Aunt Xia. Just let me know when the time comes. I'll do something at night, other people's business." Zhao An responded calmly.
"That's ok. I'm going to the Internet cafe. Oh, by the way, if you finish your homework, remember to copy it for me." Zhang Chang smiled. Being able to play games is the happiest thing.

Zhao An looked at the lottery ticket in his hand. Tomorrow is the lottery time. By then, he will be a rich man with a net worth of more than 400 million! More than 400 million is all money, without a bit of oil and water. Whether he continues to speculate in stocks or invest in real industries, he will make a steady profit.
When he thought of this, Zhao An's mind began to become active. It's true that he has money, but now he still lacks a warm bed. At least he has to find a nanny for himself!
Rose Bar, this is a famous chaotic area. No one likes to meddle in other people's business here.

Zhao An came all the way to the fifth floor with a mask on, knocked out the two bodyguards at the door and pushed open the door. In the office, he saw a burly man hugging a charming prostitute and kissing her, as if he was ready to do business.
"Who the hell are you!" Bao Xiong roared angrily.
"Get lost!" Zhao An yelled at her, and then knocked the woman unconscious with a knife.
Bao Xiong quickly picked up the pistol and pointed it at Zhao An, thinking that someone was coming to deal with him.
Zhao An rushed over, slashed Bao Xiong's wrist with a knife, and then knocked him to the ground with a punch.
He took the opponent's pistol with his gloved right hand, and saw that there was a silencer on it, and immediately fired five shots with a grin.
These five shots scared Bao Xiong to death, "No, I don't know, I don't know who did it!"
"Ding, get the gun skill expertise, using the pistol can improve the accuracy, and can hit the target within the maximum design range!"
This is dispensable for Zhao An, maybe it will be useful in the future, but now is not the time.
"What's your name?" Zhao An said in a hoarse voice.
Bao Xiong was a little confused, thinking, "You don't even know who I am, so why are you here to deal with me?" But he said obediently, "My name is Bao Xiong."
"Age?"
"33 years old."
"Are you married?"
"No."
"Do you have athlete's foot?"
Bao Xiong was depressed and could only answer, "No."
After asking five random questions, Zhao An saw into Bao Xiong's heart.
It turned out that Bao Xiong was a famous ruthless person. The detention center was his home. He went in and out and had no idea how many criminal records he had.

"Haha, March 10, June 3, July 18, and August 28. The things that happened in these four dates were not discovered by others. You think you are proud of this, right?" Zhao An sneered and said the four dates. These four dates were the dates of Bao Xiong's murders.
Bao Xiong was extremely shocked, "Who are you?"

"Haha, you don't need to know, you just need to know, listen to me, I promise you will be fine, if you dare not listen. You have done enough to make you eat peanuts, I will contact you by phone, you'd better be alert." Zhao An sneered.

In an hour, Bao Xiong lost his temper. He was extremely afraid of Zhao An. He didn't know who the other party was, but the other party even knew when he went to the toilet. Such a terrifying insight made him a little scared.

"Prostitution without paying? This is interesting." Zhao An said with a smile, then shook his head and walked to the gym. He still needed to exercise. Only with a good physique can he conquer women.

"Hello, what's the matter?" Zhao An responded lightly, his muscles were clearly ridged, not like a strong man, but showing shark muscles like Wolverine, without excess fat.
A female voice came from the phone, which seemed a little familiar, "Zhao An, this is Lin Cui, your chemistry teacher."

"Oh, Teacher Lin, what's the matter?" Zhao An was a little confused. He didn't know why the other party called him, nor did he know where he got the phone number. However, the impression of Teacher Lin flashed through her mind. This was a 42-year-old woman who wore a pair of big glasses all day and always dressed very conservatively. She was really stunning when she didn't wear glasses before. The reason for the impression was that Teacher Lin was a divorced woman who brought up a child alone.

"Does Zhao An know anyone in the police station?" Lin Cui asked a little nervously. He had overheard the principal's conversation when he went to sign a document by accident, and seemed to be a little afraid of Zhao An. It happened that her son had an accident, and the first thing she thought of was to find Zhao An. After all, Zhao An's mother was a lawyer, and she was also very kind, and seemed to be easier to talk to.
"I know him, what's the matter?" Zhao An asked lightly, picking up a bottle of beverage and drinking it to relieve his thirst.
